hints.title: Count Soldiers per Row
hints.text: Because each row has all 1s appearing before 0s, you can count soldiers using a logarithmic cutoff or sum.

hints.title: Form Pair and Sort
hints.text: Pair each row index with its soldier count: (soldier_count, row_index).

hints.title: Take First K Indices
hints.text: Sort the pairs ascending by soldier count, breaking ties by smaller row index. Return the first k row indices.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def kWeakestRows(self, mat: list[list[int]], k: int) -> list[int]:
        pairs = [(sum(row), i) for i, row in enumerate(mat)]
        pairs.sort()
        return [i for _, i in pairs[:k]]
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning every cell without binary search takes O(M * N); sorting pairs takes O(M log M).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Binary search on 1s in each row plus sorting row pairs produces results quickly.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate exploits the sorted row property (all 1s precede 0s) and sorts by (soldiers, index).
complexity.notes: Can also use a max-heap of size K for O(M log K) space-time.
